title: Central Library
content:
DAVIET Central Library is described on the official site as fully computerized and air-conditioned. Students have access to lending, reference, paperback, non-print media, and journals (current and back volumes). The site states a collection of over 36,000 volumes and 9,598 e-books. Online access to various national and international journals is provided. All students, faculty, and employees may use library facilities after taking library membership. The Central Library was initially set up in 2001 and shifted to the Knowledge Centre in June 2010.

Working hours (as published):
- Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM to 6:30 PM
- Saturday: 8:00 AM to 4:25 PM
- Closed on Sundays and gazetted holidays

Circulation timings (as published):
- 9:00 AM to 4:25 PM
- 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM (as listed on the page for the second slot)

Contact (as published): Librarian Dr. Harmanpreet Singh Sandhu; email librarian@davietjal.org.

Note: Digital library / DELNET login details, if any, should be obtained only through official library channels — not via this chatbot.
